section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section distinguishes between the refinement of sparks in Solomon's time, which required the nations to come to him, and the future refinement, where the essence of things will be revealed in their own place.
section.t: And there is another distinction between the refinement that was in the days of Shlomo and the refinement that will be in the future,
For the refinement of the sparks among the nations was by their coming to him.
But before they came to him, they were not yet refined.
For although the revelation that shone through Shlomo also shone upon the sparks in distant places and drew them to come to him,
nevertheless,
their actual refinement was specifically after they came to him.
As is understood from the fact that even after the Queen of Sheba heard of Shlomo's fame,
it was necessary that "she came to Jerusalem"64,
and only then was the refinement accomplished65.
For since their refinement was not from their own side but from the revelation that shone upon them,
therefore,
their refinement was when they came to the place where the revelation is.
But the refinement of the future,
since the refinement then will be by the revelation of the true reality of the things being refined themselves,
therefore,
then66
"I will transform the peoples"
(as they are in their reality and in their place)
etc. "to serve Him with one accord."

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that through the spreading of the wellsprings of Chassidus, which is the aspect of the innermost dimension of Atik, the natural powers of a person become G-dly powers, revealing that the true reality of the "outside" is the wellsprings themselves.
section.t: A)
And correspondingly, it is regarding the matter of the spreading of the wellsprings outward
(which is the preparation and vessel for "He will come, the Master, King Moshiach"67),
that the Torah of Chassidus is the aspect of the innermost dimension of Atik.
And this is that through the study of the Torah of Chassidus and walking in the ways of Chassidus,
the natural powers
(of the one engaged in Chassidus)
become G-dly powers68,
for through the drawing down of the revelation of the innermost dimension of Atik,
there is felt within him
(in concealment, at least)
that the true reality of his existence is his [true] reality.
And the concept of "Your wellsprings will spread outward" is,
that even in the aspect of "outward" there will be
(and in a manner of spreading)
not only the living waters that are drawn from the wellsprings
[similar to the revelation of the external dimension of Atik that was in the days of Shlomo,
where the main revelation was in Jerusalem but an illumination from it was drawn also to distant places],
but the wellsprings themselves.
And through this, the reality of the "outward" itself is revealed,
that the true reality of its existence is the wellsprings.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains the Rebbe Rashab's analogy of the olive that yields its oil, showing that the revelation after Yud-Tes Kislev is like oil that permeates everything, because the innermost dimension of Atik, though utterly separate, is precisely what spreads outward.
section.t: And based on this, we can explain the saying of the Rebbe
(the Rebbe Rashab)
of blessed memory69
regarding the revelation of the Torah of Chassidus that was drawn down by the Alter Rebbe after Petersburg, that it is like the olive which, when crushed, yields its oil70,
for among the reasons for this, that the revelation after Yud-Tes Kislev is compared to oil, is,
because oil71,
despite being separate from everything
(therefore it does not mix with any other liquid72),
nevertheless, it permeates everything73
(meaning,
that the oil itself permeates everything,
and not merely that it affects it).
And correspondingly, regarding the revelation of Yud-Tes Kislev,
that the fact that then the main concept of "Your wellsprings will spread outward"74 began,
is because then the revelation of the innermost dimension of Atik was drawn down,
for the innermost dimension of Atik is separate from all of Hishtalshelus
(and certainly from the "outward")
even more than the external dimension of Atik
(analogous to oil which does not mix with other liquids),
and nevertheless,
and for this very reason,
specifically after Yud-Tes Kislev did the concept of "Your wellsprings will spread outward" begin,
so that in the "outward" there are the wellsprings themselves
(analogous to oil which itself permeates everything).
